title: SC-Pro: Training-Free Framework for Defending Unsafe Image Synthesis Attack
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical defense mechanism (SC-Pro) to prevent text-to-image and image-to-image diffusion models from generating NSFW (Not Safe For Work) content. While it mentions AI safety and 'ethical standards' for responsible AI, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or philosophical/secular ethical frameworks.
